en.headline: Veteran lyricist and actor Peter Lai dies at 76
en.dek: The Cantopop pioneer, known for classics written with Sam Hui and his role as Uncle Pau in a long-running TVB sitcom, passed away on Wednesday morning after months of declining health.
body: Hong Kong lyricist and actor Peter Lai Pei-tak died on Wednesday morning at the age of 76, his close friend Eric Chung Chi-kwong confirmed. Lai had been bedridden since suffering a stroke at a nursing home in early March.

Chung said he visited Lai on his birthday in May and sang to him, but Lai was already unresponsive. The two had tea together only days before the stroke, when Lai was still in good spirits. The family has asked for private funeral arrangements.

Lai rose to prominence in the 1970s through a seven-year partnership with Sam Hui, writing lyrics for songs including The Private Eyes, The Drifter’s Song and Here Comes Fortune. He later wrote for Alan Tam, Leslie Cheung, Roman Tam and Anita Mui, with credits including Leslie Cheung’s Monica.
He was also a familiar face on television as the character Uncle Pau in the long-running TVB sitcom Come Home Love: Lo And Behold.

zh.headline: 填詞人兼演員黎彼得因病離世 享年76歲
zh.dek: 殿堂級填詞人黎彼得周三早上離世，好友鍾志光證實消息，指他今年3月中風後一直臥床，家人希望低調處理後事。
body: 香港資深填詞人兼演員黎彼得（原名黎成就）於周三早上因病離世，享年76歲。好友鍾志光向傳媒證實死訊，透露黎彼得今年3月初在護老院中風後一直臥床，身體機能逐漸衰退。
鍾志光表示，他在5月13日黎彼得生日當天曾探望並為他唱生日歌，當時黎彼得已無反應。中風前數天兩人仍有飲茶，當時黎彼得精神尚可。家人希望低調處理後事。
黎彼得1970年代與許冠傑合作七年，寫下《半斤八両》、《浪子心聲》及《財神到》等經典。他亦曾為譚詠麟、張國榮、羅文及梅艷芳填詞，包括張國榮的《Monica》。
在演藝方面，他長期出演無綫處境劇《愛回家之開心速遞》，飾演「豹叔」一角，為觀眾熟悉。
